overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the May 25, 2011 executive session with CVEC representatives was proper under Purpose 3 litigation strategy, and the minutes did list the non-member attendees.

allegations.summary: Commissioners allegedly entered executive session with CVEC representatives to shield their deliberations from public view.
allegations.key_passage: The Commissioners did not violate the Open Meeting Law on May 25, 2011 by entering into executive session, pursuant to Purpose 3, to discuss litigation strategy with representatives of the CVEC.

allegations.summary: Commissioners allegedly did not state or record in minutes the names of non-member attendees, including CVEC representatives and their general counsel, in executive session.
allegations.key_passage: The executive session minutes for the Commissioners' May 25, 2011 executive session meeting do, in fact, include a full list of names and titles of the non-Commissioners who participated in the meeting.
